auth.greetIn: The table is set. Take your seat.
auth.name: Name
auth.toSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.

home.title: Your campaigns
home.inviteInvalid: This invite is no longer valid. Ask the GM for a new link.

wizard.sheetHint: You'll draw the fields later. You can skip this for now.
wizard.mapHint: It becomes the active scene, with a 70 px grid already on.
wizard.coverHint: It shows on the campaign card. Without one, we use a picture of your last session or the map.
wizard.doneHint: Paste this link on Discord. Whoever opens it joins as a player.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.hint: How do you want to appear at the table? If you don't pick a photo, you'll get the default avatar. You can change it later in Settings.

settings.title: Settings
settings.coverFallback: Without a cover, the card shows a picture of the last session or the map.
settings.newLinkHint: New link (the old one stops working)
settings.deleteConfirm: This deletes everything. Type the campaign name to confirm:

sheets.title: Sheets
sheets.introGm: Click a character to open their sheet, and choose who plays each one.
sheets.introPlayer: Click a character to open their sheet.
sheets.name: Name
sheets.ownersHint: Only the people checked can open and edit this sheet. The GM always has access.
sheets.ownersEmpty: Nobody checked: only the GM can open this sheet.
sheets.ownersNew: With nobody checked, this becomes a GM creature.
sheets.noTemplates: The GM hasn't uploaded any sheet yet.
sheets.extraSheetHint: Another sheet for this character, like a companion or mount
sheets.templatesHint: Templates are the table's sheet PDFs, with fields drawn on top. Every sheet starts from a template.
sheets.deleteTemplateConfirm: Delete the {name} template? All its sheets go with it.
sheets.dropPdf: Drop a PDF to create a new template

table.select: Select and move (V). Drag on empty space to box-select; right button or Space pans the map.
table.alignGridHint: Align grid: click 2 corners of one square
table.noSceneGm: Drag a map image here to create the first scene.
table.noScenePlayer: The GM hasn't opened a scene yet.
table.layerHint: Switch between token layer and GM layer
table.effectRoundsHint: Duration of effects turned on here. Empty: stays until removed.
table.dragActors: Drag onto the map to create the token.
table.dropImage: Or drop any image on the map (hold Alt to put it on the GM layer).

scenes.title: Scenes
scenes.activateHint: Bring every player to this scene
scenes.name: Scene name
scenes.dungeonHint: The map starts dark and players uncover it as they explore
scenes.dungeonTools: Lights, walls and reveal area are on the left toolbar.
scenes.emptySession: Drag scenes here or drop a map.
scenes.deleteSessionConfirm: Delete session {name}? Its scenes stay, under "No session".
scenes.resetFogConfirm: Hide again everything players explored and everything that was revealed?

music.manageHint: Tick the music that plays in {scene}. With none ticked, the defaults play. Music imported here joins the scene right away.
music.noTracks: No music for this state. Import it from the gear.
music.empty: Nothing here yet. Import your sounds in Manage.
music.noScene: Create a scene to set up its sound.
music.musicCount: {chosen} of {n} {n, plural, one {track} other {tracks}} in this scene
music.dropHere: Drop files here or click to import

combat.title: Combat
combat.emptyGm: Select tokens on the map (Shift+click) and click "Start combat", or add a quick NPC.
combat.initiativeHint: Rolls for whoever has no initiative yet
combat.rerollConfirm: Reroll initiative for everyone? Values typed by hand will be replaced.
combat.noTokens: No tokens outside combat in this scene.
combat.hpHint: Type a value and click Damage or Heal. On Enter: -7 damages, +5 heals, 12 sets HP.
combat.setHpHint: Type the total HP. The bar and the Damage and Heal buttons appear after that.

wiki.emptyPlayer: The GM hasn't shared any pages yet.
wiki.exportHint: Download the whole wiki as Markdown + images (zip)
wiki.importHint: Import a zip exported by Grimório
wiki.deleteFolderConfirm: Delete the "{name}" folder? Its contents move up one level.
wiki.folderEmpty: Empty folder. Drag pages here or use the + in the tree.
wiki.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}" and the pages inside it?
wiki.pick: Pick a page on the side, or press <key>Ctrl K</key> to search.
wiki.title: Page title
